dedupe_keys.name: experimental cooling data in kubik lab building during the 2020 season holisder project pre pilot testing activities

description: TECNALIA publishes raw HVAC measurements from a HOLISDER pre-validation test in its KUBIK experimental building. Zenodo offers a public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0. The test ran from 1 July to 31 October 2020 at ten-minute resolution. The own page describes two ground-floor fan coils, two basement chillers and SCADA signals for room and outdoor temperature, water flow and temperature, set points, operating modes, electrical power and cumulative thermal energy. These measurements can calibrate chiller or fan-coil operation in a building-energy simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this 2020 cooling series. A limitation is that the provider explicitly left null and error values in the raw data. The experiment covers one building zone and cooling season, not a general office stock or heating operation. Equipment calibration, sensor failures and exact workbook schema were not independently checked. No workbook was downloaded and no energy balance was reproduced.
